tagline: One heavy command at a time
brief: A CLI that puts every heavy shell command from every coding-agent session on one machine into a single queue, so parallel builds and test runs can't swap a laptop to death. It should feel precise, fair and calm.
criteria: Distinct from terminal-prompt and gear marks, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, says 'many requests, one grant'.

concepts.name: Split Grant
concepts.idea: A circle split in two: four requests on the left, the gate on the right, and one dot that gets the grant.
rationale: Borrowed from the hardware arbiter: many request lines, one grant
One circle, one split, one dot: holds at 16 px (3-stripe small cut below 24 px)
Grant green is the 'go' signal, rare among dev-tool blues

recommendation: Split Grant in ink #14161A with Grant Green #0FA36B for icon tiles and accents.
next_steps: Add the logo to the README header
Use web icons on any docs site
